description: This is a Java source file defining the `TextureRenderer` class, which handles rendering textures using OpenGL ES 2.0 in an Android environment. It includes shader code, buffer setup, and rendering logic for displaying textures with aspect ratio considerations.

classes.name: TextureRenderer
classes.description: A class that encapsulates OpenGL ES 2.0 code to render textures, including shader compilation, buffer setup, and viewport management, for Android applications.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the shader program, fetches attribute and uniform locations, and sets up coordinate buffers.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Deletes the OpenGL program to free resources.

methods.name: updateTextureSize
methods.description: Updates the texture dimensions and recalculates output vertices to maintain aspect ratio.

methods.name: updateViewSize
methods.description: Sets the view dimensions and recalculates output vertices for correct aspect ratio rendering.

methods.name: renderTexture
methods.description: Performs rendering of the specified texture ID onto the current OpenGL framebuffer, configuring viewport, shaders, and vertex attributes.

methods.name: computeOutputVertices
methods.description: Calculates vertex coordinates to maintain aspect ratio based on texture and view sizes.
